description: This file implements RADIUS server functionality within a Wi-Fi access point, including TLS event handling, user data management, RADIUS attribute parsing, and server setup and teardown.

methods.name: radius_tls_event
methods.description: Handles TLS events such as certificate verification, alerts, and peer certificate info, logging relevant messages.

methods.name: radius_userdata_init
methods.description: Initializes radius_user_data structure by setting up kvlist and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with radius_user_data, including kvlist and AVL tree elements.

methods.name: radius_userdata_load
methods.description: Loads user data from JSON file into radius_user_data structure, parsing 'users' and 'wildcard' entries.

methods.name: load_userfile
methods.description: Loads and updates user data from specified user file if modified, managing phase1 and phase2 user states.

methods.name: radius_user_get
methods.description: Retrieves user attribute data by username, matching exact or wildcard patterns.

methods.name: radius_parse_attr
methods.description: Parses RADIUS attribute data from blob message, determining format and size.

methods.name: radius_count_attrs
methods.description: Counts total attributes and size needed for RADIUS attribute list based on user data.

methods.name: radius_add_attr
methods.description: Adds a RADIUS attribute to the attribute list, handling vendor-specific attributes.

methods.name: radius_parse_attrs
methods.description: Parses and adds RADIUS attributes from user data blobs into attribute list.

methods.name: radius_user_parse_methods
methods.description: Parses EAP methods from user data and updates EAP user structure accordingly.

methods.name: radius_user_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves or creates EAP user state for a given username, parsing user attributes.

methods.name: radius_get_eap_user
methods.description: Callback to retrieve EAP user info based on identity, supporting phase1 and phase2.

methods.name: radius_setup
methods.description: Initializes EAP and TLS configurations, and sets up the radius server.

methods.name: radius_init
methods.description: Initializes radius_state structure, including user data.

methods.name: radius_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes radius_state, freeing resources and shutting down server components.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the radius main program.

methods.name: radius_main
methods.description: Main entry point for RADIUS server application, parsing command-line options, initializing components, and running event loop.
